response.sql: WITH scope_counts AS (SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) as count FROM riskandmargin rm INNER JOIN orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT acctscope, count, count * 1.0 / SUM(count) OVER () as share, count * 1.0 / (SUM(count) OVER () / COUNT(*) OVER ()) as count_div_avg FROM scope_counts
